classification_contract.exact-documentation: Requires a documented immutable upstream read/path/object linked to the initial adaptation; none met that standard.
classification_contract.bounded-candidate: Surviving historical clone plus original declaration, path/name or preserved content identifiers supports comparison candidates only. This is not an exhaustive bound on all possible upstream revisions.
classification_contract.history-exhausted: All available sources enumerated by the scope were checked and no supported original adaptation read chain was found. Later review evidence is separate.
classification_contract.path-or-name-corroborated: A relatively stronger comparison lead supported by a path, alias or retained name, not exact-origin verification.
classification_contract.content-retrieval-lead: Automatic preserved-identifier retrieval only; requires manual matching before promotion to a verified mapping.

origin_policy: All origin revisions remain unrecorded/null. Neither an early clone nor a later fixed comparison snapshot proves the original adaptation revision.
